mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_milestone (project_id, name, description, status, start_date, end_date, sort_order, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: m.id, m.project_id AS projectId, m.name, m.description, m.status, m.start_date AS startDate, m.end_date AS endDate, m.sort_order AS sortOrder, COUNT(t.id) AS taskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS taskDone, m.create_time AS createTime, m.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_milestone m LEFT JOIN lab_task t ON t.milestone_id = m.id AND t.project_id = m.project_id WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.id = #{milestoneId} GROUP BY m.id, m.project_id, m.name, m.description, m.status, m.start_date, m.end_date, m.sort_order, m.create_time, m.update_time
